previous_text: All LLM-generated explanations MUST be produced using StarCoder-15B.
new_text: All LLM-generated explanations MUST be produced using TinyLlama-1.1B (primary for CPU feasibility) or CodeLlama-7B (fallback).
rationale: Amend Principle VII to authorize TinyLlama-1.1B as primary for CPU feasibility, with CodeLlama-7B as fallback. This aligns the Constitution with the Plan's execution strategy.
conflict_resolution: Resolved conflict between Spec FR-001 (CodeLlama-7B mandate) and Plan Constraints (TinyLlama-1.1B primary for CPU). The amendment explicitly authorizes the dual-model strategy to satisfy both feasibility and intent.
